name: Vietnamese-Style Caramelized Salmon with Edamame, Broccoli Slaw & Rice

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes
3 small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger; place in a large bowl.
Zest and juice limes into the bowl with the ginger. Add sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, and water; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup brown sugar
¼ cup fish sauce
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp water

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Cut salmon into equal portions, pat dry with paper towels, and place on a plate; drizzle skin-side with oil, then sprinkle with salt and pepper on both sides. Divide sauce between two ovenproof skillets, then place salmon, skin-side down, in the sauce. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, place skillets in the oven and broil until salmon is just opaque, about 5 minutes. Flip salmon and continue to broil until the skin is crispy, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the salmon cooks, place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Set aside to drain.
Place oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl along with the broccoli slaw and edamame. Toss to combine the slaw.
When the salmon is done, transfer to a clean plate.
Place skillets over medium-high heat and cook, stirring frequently, until sauce begins to thicken and caramelize, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, salmon, and slaw between bowls; spoon sauce over salmon and top with reserved green onion. Enjoy!
